decision: Do not add this redundant early-rejection wrapper to production. Existing segmentHitsShip already performs the same posed-ship broadphase before segmentBox. In the ordinary neutral comparison both paths execute77124 active-ship bound tests and zero narrow-phase box tests. Suppressing entry to a named function is not eliminating its work.
selectedHypothesis: A cache-free rejection using existing current posed ship bounds can avoid meaningful native narrow-phase solid-query work. No other optimization, cache variant or broad tuning investigated.
authoredBoundProof: geography.ts:79-91 derives REACH as max hypot(abs(center.x)+half.x,abs(center.z)+half.z)+1 over each native authored collision box. Yaw rotation preserves radial distance; the posed-center square using REACH+5 contains every rotated box footprint. This is the existing native collision-box contract, not rendered mesh/physics-hardware certification.

TOP is max(center.y+half.y) over those boxes. segmentBox uses absolute world Y with zero fleet vertical displacement. A linear segment wholly above TOP cannot hit a box; disjoint endpoint X/Z intervals cannot hit its enclosing footprint. Strict< and> retain inclusive contacts.

The candidate is lifted directly from segmentHitsShip current rejection prefix. If no ACTIVE ship passes, original would perform no segmentBox calls and return null. Otherwise candidate delegates to original unchanged. ACTIVE/POSED/REACH/TOP are read anew per query; no answer/endpoint cache, static geometry snapshot, room/frame lease or invalidation rule is introduced.

setFleetState updates poses and team/platform masks; setShipStates updates solidity independently of fleetState match-clock tuple. Targeted comparisons cover pose motion, solid cutoff/reactivation and team removal. Nonfinite plain-vector cases only check original compatibility; no new validation contract is claimed.

experiment.method: Existing retained loader executes actual TypeScript without emitted files. A process-local load hook inserts native-entry/active-bound/segmentBox counters and exports the lifted live bounds predicate. No tracked geography bytes change. One original and one candidate neutral movement call use the same declared ordinary factory pose and four separated boat-collider records. Ordered ground/water/seabed/solid answers, full supplied state and peer records match.
